module.purpose: Manages Suspense handler stack and shell boundary tracking for React's fiber reconciler, plus SuspenseList context bitmask utilities.
module.summary: This module provides the mechanism to track the nearest Suspense boundary (handler) on a stack cursor during React rendering. It distinguishes the 'shell' (visible stale UI) from deeper hidden trees to decide whether showing a fallback is desirable. It exposes push/pop functions for different rendering scenarios (primary, fallback, activity, offscreen, SuspenseList) and helpers to manipulate SuspenseList context flags used for forced fallbacks. Opaque types enforce compile-time separation of subtree vs shallow contexts.
module.businessContext: Core React rendering internals; if broken, Suspense fallbacks show incorrectly causing UI flicker or stuck loading states.
functions: getShellBoundary (~L39-41): Returns the current outermost non-visible shell boundary fiber.
pushPrimaryTreeSuspenseHandler (~L43-102): Pushes primary suspense handler and updates shell boundary logic.
pushFallbackTreeSuspenseHandler (~L104-109): Reuses handler when rendering fallback to prevent capturing suspense.
pushDehydratedActivitySuspenseHandler (~L111-124): Pushes handler for dehydrated Activity boundary and sets shell.
pushOffscreenSuspenseHandler (~L126-143): Pushes handler for Offscreen or LegacyHidden, updating shell boundary.
reuseSuspenseHandlerOnStack (~L145-148): Pushes current handler and suspense context for given fiber.
getSuspenseHandler (~L150-152): Returns the current suspense handler from stack cursor.
popSuspenseHandler (~L154-161): Pops handler and clears shell boundary if it matches fiber.
hasSuspenseListContext (~L182-187): Returns whether parent context contains given flag bit.
setDefaultShallowSuspenseListContext (~L189-193): Masks parent context to subtree bits only.
setShallowSuspenseListContext (~L195-200): Combines subtree mask with shallow suspense context bits.
pushSuspenseListContext (~L202-211): Pushes SuspenseList context reusing current handler.
pushSuspenseListCatch (~L213-225): Pushes SuspenseList context catching on boundary, sets shell.
popSuspenseListContext (~L227-234): Pops SuspenseList context and resets shell boundary.

units.name: getShellBoundary

detail.name: getShellBoundary
postconditions: Returns the current value of the module-level `shellBoundary` binding without mutation.
invariants: The returned value is always of type Fiber or null.
edgeCases: If `shellBoundary` has not been assigned yet, returns null.
detail.summary: Returns the module-level suspense boundary Fiber (or null) referenced by the `shellBoundary` variable, providing read access to the current active suspense boundary.

units.name: pushPrimaryTreeSuspenseHandler

detail.name: pushPrimaryTreeSuspenseHandler
preconditions: The 'handler' argument must be a valid Fiber node with 'pendingProps', 'alternate', and 'memoizedState' fields.
The module-level 'suspenseStackCursor', 'suspenseHandlerStackCursor', and 'shellBoundary' must be initialized.
If 'enableSuspenseAvoidThisFallback' is true, 'isCurrentTreeHidden()' must be callable.
postconditions: The suspense stack cursor is updated to reflect the new shallow suspense context.
The suspense handler stack cursor is pushed with either the handler itself or a parent handler when avoid-this-fallback is active.
If no shell boundary was previously assigned, this handler may become the shell boundary.
invariants: The 'ForceSuspenseFallback' and other shallow suspense context fields are only propagated one level deep.
When 'unstable_avoidThisFallback' is true and a parent boundary exists, the parent handler is preferred over the current one.
edgeCases: If 'enableSuspenseAvoidThisFallback' is enabled and 'props.unstable_avoidThisFallback' is not strictly true, the handler is always pushed onto the handler stack.
If 'shellBoundary' is null and the handler is not hidden, it is assigned as the new shell boundary.
If 'shellBoundary' is not null and the current tree is hidden, the handler is still pushed but not assigned as shell boundary.
If a parent boundary already exists with avoidThisFallback behavior, the parent handler is reused instead of the current handler.
stateMutations: Mutates module-level 'shellBoundary' when conditions are met.
detail.summary: Pushes the given suspense handler onto the suspense stack and shallow context cursors, determining whether it becomes the active shell boundary or defers to a parent boundary based on avoid-this-fallback semantics.

units.name: pushFallbackTreeSuspenseHandler

detail.name: pushFallbackTreeSuspenseHandler
preconditions: A valid Fiber instance is provided as the argument.
A suspense handler stack is already instantiated and accessible via internal context.
postconditions: The provided Fiber is associated with the current suspense handler on the stack.
No new handler is created; the existing handler is reused.
invariants: Reuses the existing handler on the stack instead of creating a new one.
edgeCases: If fallback content suspends during rendering, it must not be captured by this boundary.
Ensures consistent reuse semantics even when fallback subtree is deeply nested.
stateMutations: Internal suspense handler stack state is mutated via reuseSuspenseHandlerOnStack.
detail.summary: Registers a fallback tree suspense handler by reusing the existing handler on the suspense stack, ensuring nested suspenses within the fallback do not trigger redundant boundary captures.

units.name: pushDehydratedActivitySuspenseHandler

detail.name: pushDehydratedActivitySuspenseHandler
preconditions: The suspenseStackCursor is initialized and has a current value.
The suspenseHandlerStackCursor is initialized.
The shellBoundary variable is accessible in module scope.
The fiber argument is a valid Fiber node.
postconditions: The suspenseStackCursor is pushed with its current value and the fiber.
The suspenseHandlerStackCursor is pushed with the fiber.
If shellBoundary is null, it is set to the provided fiber.
invariants: shellBoundary, once set to a non-null value, is not overwritten if already assigned.
The suspense stack and handler stack cursors are updated atomically with respect to the fiber.
edgeCases: When shellBoundary is null, this function sets it to the fiber — establishing the first shell boundary.
When shellBoundary is already non-null, it remains unchanged.
The fiber may suspend during hydration while still being dehydrated — no additional handling is performed here.
detail.summary: Pushes a Suspense handler for an Activity boundary being hydrated, updating the suspense stack cursor and suspense handler stack, and sets the shell boundary to the fiber if none is set.

units.name: pushOffscreenSuspenseHandler

detail.name: pushOffscreenSuspenseHandler
preconditions: fiber is a valid Fiber node
SuspenseStackCursor and SuspenseHandlerStackCursor are initialized
postconditions: If fiber.tag === OffscreenComponent, suspenseStackCursor is pushed with its current value, suspenseHandlerStackCursor is pushed with fiber, and shellBoundary is set to fiber if it was null
If fiber.tag !== OffscreenComponent, reuseSuspenseHandlerOnStack is called with fiber
invariants: The function maintains consistency between suspense stack cursor and suspense handler stack cursor
shellBoundary remains null until an OffscreenComponent with hidden content is encountered during rendering
edgeCases: fiber.tag === OffscreenComponent: Performs full push sequence
fiber.tag !== OffscreenComponent (LegacyHidden): Delegates to reuseSuspenseHandlerOnStack
shellBoundary === null when handling OffscreenComponent: Sets shellBoundary to current fiber
detail.summary: Pushes an OffscreenComponent suspense handler onto the relevant stacks, updating the shell boundary if none is set, or reuses the current handler for legacy hidden components.

specTests.then: suspenseStackCursor and suspenseHandlerStackCursor are pushed, and shellBoundary is set to the fiber
reuseSuspenseHandlerOnStack is called with the fiber and no stack cursors are pushed

units.name: reuseSuspenseHandlerOnStack

detail.name: reuseSuspenseHandlerOnStack
preconditions: The `fiber` parameter must be a valid Fiber instance.
The `push` function and `suspenseStackCursor` and `suspenseHandlerStackCursor` must be initialized before calling this function.
The `getSuspenseHandler` function must be available in scope.
postconditions: The current value of `suspenseStackCursor` is pushed onto its stack using the provided `fiber`.
The current suspense handler, retrieved via `getSuspenseHandler()`, is pushed onto `suspenseHandlerStackCursor` using the provided `fiber`.
invariants: Each invocation of `reuseSuspenseHandlerOnStack` results in a corresponding entry in both `suspenseStackCursor` and `suspenseHandlerStackCursor`.
The pushed values remain until explicitly popped or overwritten by another call to `push`.
detail.summary: Reuses the current suspense handler and stack context by pushing the fiber-related suspense state onto the suspense stack and handler stack cursors, allowing child fibers to inherit the same suspense context during reconciliation.

units.name: getSuspenseHandler

detail.name: getSuspenseHandler
postconditions: Returns the current value of suspenseHandlerStackCursor without modifying any state.
invariants: The return value reflects the most recently pushed suspense handler in the current reconciliation stack.
edgeCases: If no suspense handler has been pushed, returns null.
detail.summary: Returns the current suspense handler from the suspense handler stack cursor, enabling callers to access the active Suspense boundary during tree reconciliation.

units.name: popSuspenseHandler

detail.name: popSuspenseHandler
preconditions: A Fiber is on the stack pushed by pushPrimaryTreeSuspenseHandler, pushFallbackTreeSuspenseHandler, pushDehydratedActivitySuspenseHandler, pushOffscreenSuspenseHandler, or pushSuspenseListContext.
postconditions: The suspenseHandlerStackCursor value is restored to its prior value on the Fiber's stack.
The suspenseStackCursor value is restored to its prior value on the Fiber's stack.
If the Fiber being popped is the current shellBoundary, shellBoundary is reset to null.
stateMutations: shellBoundary set to null when fiber === shellBoundary
detail.summary: Pops the given Fiber from the suspense handler and suspense stacks, resetting the shell boundary back to null when the popped Fiber was the current shell boundary.

units.name: hasSuspenseListContext

detail.name: hasSuspenseListContext
detail.signature: export function hasSuspenseListContext(parentContext: SuspenseContext, flag: SuspenseContext): boolean
postconditions: (parentContext & flag) !== 0 === result
edgeCases: When parentContext and flag share no set bits, result is false
When parentContext and flag share at least one set bit, result is true
When parentContext is 0, result is always false regardless of flag
detail.summary: Checks whether a given SuspenseContext flag is active in the provided parent context using a bitwise AND operation, returning true if any overlapping bits are set.

specLiterals.role: used as the comparison value in the bitwise check to determine if any overlapping bits are set

specTests.then: it returns true because the second bit is set in both values
it returns false because no bits overlap between the two values

units.name: setDefaultShallowSuspenseListContext

detail.name: setDefaultShallowSuspenseListContext
preconditions: parentContext is of type SuspenseContext (numeric bitmask)
postconditions: returns the bitwise AND of parentContext and SubtreeSuspenseContextMask
returned value is a SuspenseContext with non-subtree bits cleared
edgeCases: if parentContext has no bits within SubtreeSuspenseContextMask, returns 0
bitwise AND never sets bits that were not already set in parentContext
detail.summary: Returns a SuspenseContext derived from a parent context by masking it with SubtreeSuspenseContextMask, preserving only subtree-level suspense flags.

units.name: setShallowSuspenseListContext

detail.name: setShallowSuspenseListContext
detail.signature: export function setShallowSuspenseListContext(parentContext: SuspenseContext, shallowContext: ShallowSuspenseContext): SuspenseContext
preconditions: parentContext is a SuspenseContext bitmask
shallowContext is a ShallowSuspenseContext bitmask
postconditions: returns a SuspenseContext equal to (parentContext & SubtreeSuspenseContextMask) | shallowContext
edgeCases: When shallowContext is 0, the returned context retains only the subtree bits of parentContext
When parentContext is 0, the returned context equals shallowContext
detail.summary: Combines a parent suspense context with a shallow suspense context by preserving the parent's subtree bits and overriding the shallow bits, returning a new SuspenseContext bitmask.

units.name: pushSuspenseListContext

detail.name: pushSuspenseListContext
detail.signature: export function pushSuspenseListContext(fiber: Fiber, newContext: SuspenseContext): void
preconditions: A valid Fiber instance must be provided as the first argument.
A SuspenseContext object must be provided as the second argument.
postconditions: The suspenseHandlerStackCursor will hold the previous handler value at the fiber level.
The suspenseStackCursor will hold the newContext value at the fiber level.
invariants: The previous handler from suspenseHandlerStackCursor.current is preserved and pushed, not discarded.
detail.summary: Pushes the current suspense handler and a new suspense context onto their respective fiber-level cursors for SuspenseList handling during render.

units.name: pushSuspenseListCatch

detail.name: pushSuspenseListCatch
postconditions: The provided fiber is pushed onto the suspenseHandlerStackCursor with itself as the parent lane.
The provided newContext is pushed onto the suspenseStackCursor with the fiber as the parent lane.
If shellBoundary was null before the call, it is set to the provided fiber.
edgeCases: If shellBoundary is already set (non-null), it remains unchanged.
If shellBoundary is set, the new fiber still gets pushed onto the suspense stacks, allowing it to catch suspending on the boundary itself.
detail.summary: Pushes the given fiber as both a suspense handler and a suspense context onto the reconciler's suspense stacks, and if no shell boundary has been established yet, sets this fiber as the shell boundary for containing hiding effects.

units.name: popSuspenseListContext

detail.name: popSuspenseListContext
preconditions: The fiber argument must be a valid Fiber node currently participating in the work-in-progress tree traversal.
There must have been a corresponding prior call to pushSuspenseListContext(fiber) to ensure stack consistency.
postconditions: The suspenseStackCursor will have its top entry removed.
The suspenseHandlerStackCursor will have its top entry removed.
If the fiber was the active shellBoundary, shellBoundary will be reset to null.
invariants: Each call to popSuspenseListContext must correspond to exactly one previously matched call to a pushing function that advanced the same cursors.
edgeCases: Fiber not at top of suspend stack: pop() still removes the latest cursor entry regardless of identity.
Fiber is current shell boundary: shellBoundary becomes null to indicate no active shell during suspense handling.
Fiber was never pushed onto the cursor stack: pop() still proceeds but may lead to inconsistent state—this is caller responsibility.
stateMutations: suspenseStackCursor: top value is popped via pop() call.
suspenseHandlerStackCursor: top value is popped via pop() call.
shellBoundary global variable: set to null if fiber matches current shellBoundary.
detail.summary: Removes the suspense list context for the given Fiber from internal cursor stacks, restoring prior suspense boundary tracking state. Ensures proper unwinding of suspense handler and stack cursor entries during reconciliation traversal.

specLiterals.role: Mutability classification indicating this function does not modify reactive state directly

specTests.then: Both cursors should have their top entries removed, restoring prior values
shellBoundary global should be set to null

specTests.when: popSuspenseListContext is invoked after each matching push
specTests.then: Cursor stacks remain balanced and shellBoundary reflects last unmatched boundary state
